query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `venue_profiles` (
  `id` varchar(255) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `userId` int NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `organizationName` varchar(255),
  `contactName` varchar(255),
  `contactPhone` varchar(20),
  `location` varchar(255),
  `bio` text,
  `isListed` boolean DEFAULT true,
  `website` varchar(255),
  `email` varchar(255),
  `capacity` int,
  `venueType` varchar(100),
  `amenities` json,
  `profilePhotoUrl` varchar(500),
  `mediaGallery` json,
  `averageRating` decimal(3,2) DEFAULT 0,
  `reviewCount` int DEFAULT 0,
  `listingViews` int DEFAULT 0,
  `emailVerified` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `emailVerificationToken` varchar(255),
  `emailVerificationSentAt` datetime,
  `profileCompletionScore` int DEFAULT 0,
  `profileCompletionUpdatedAt` datetime,
  `createdAt` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (`userId`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  INDEX `idx_userId` (`userId`),
  INDEX `idx_isListed` (`isListed`),
  INDEX `idx_createdAt` (`createdAt`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
